description: A network of trails on both sides of Desous Mountain. The front side being more lower level trails in mature forest while the back side (Fraser River)features more advanced, long distance downhill trails. A newly constructed climbing line allows you to loop back to the front side.
directions:
From Williams Lake head West on Hwy 20, turn left onto Dog Creek Road and follow this towards Springhouse. Just before Springhouse the road is on your right, follow this for approximately 6km to the trailhead / camping area.

This access travels through open range area, please drive slowly and watch for livestock.
title: Desous Mountain Trails
